title: Mandatory Traffic Sign: STOP Sign (Octagonal Red Sign)
description: Octagonal red road sign with STOP text mandating vehicle driver to come to a complete halt before crossing stop line or intersection.
violation: Failing to come to complete stop at octagonal STOP sign before entering priority road.
additionalPenalty: Challan under Section 177A MVA 1988 for failing to obey mandatory road sign.
legalSection: Section 177A of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 read with IRC:67 Code of Practice for Road Signs
sourceName: Indian Roads Congress (IRC:67) / Ministry of Road Transport & Highways (MoRTH)
governmentDocument: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs

title: Mandatory Traffic Sign: GIVE WAY (Inverted Red Triangle Sign)
description: Inverted equilateral triangle sign with red border mandating driver to give way to traffic on major road.
violation: Failing to yield right-of-way to oncoming traffic at roundabout or priority junction.
additionalPenalty: Penalty under mandatory traffic sign regulations.
legalSection: Section 177A of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 read with IRC:67
governmentDocument: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs

title: Mandatory Traffic Sign: NO ENTRY (Red Circle with White Bar / Symbol)
description: Circular sign indicating prohibited entry for all motor vehicles into designated street or carriageway.
violation: Entering street or lane marked with NO ENTRY traffic sign.
additionalPenalty: Prosecution for dangerous driving under Section 184.
legalSection: Section 184(b) / 177A of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 read with IRC:67

title: Cautionary Traffic Sign: Pedestrian Crossing Ahead
description: Triangular warning sign depicting pedestrian walking on zebra line, indicating driver to slow down and yield.
violation: Failing to slow down or stopping on marked pedestrian crossing.
legalSection: Section 177A MVA 1988 read with Rule 11 of Rules of the Road Regulations, 1989
governmentDocument: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs

title: Cautionary Traffic Sign: School Zone Ahead
description: Triangular sign showing schoolchildren carrying bags, warning driver of nearby school premises and requiring low speed.
violation: Speeding or aggressive driving in marked school zone.
additionalPenalty: Fine under speed limit and safety regulations.
governmentDocument: IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs
notes: Speed limit strictly capped in school zone.
